_note: Shift+hover shows tooltip, Shift+click opens deep help. Keyed by element id or css selector. Content rules: second person, start with verb, state consequences, under 30 words for tooltips.

nav.network: Connects stations with guideways, manages the network, builds 3D geometry, and runs animation.
nav.vehicles: Shows pod vehicles in the current network. View positions, assign trips, monitor status.
nav.models: Opens, places, and tests station templates. Run Compute, chains, health checks, and the approval workflow.
nav.documentation: Generates and views network documentation — BOM, reports, and readmes.
nav.travel: Shows trip data, travel times, and passenger flow for the current network.
nav.crew: Displays agent status — Sally (slots), Natalie (routing), Nora (vehicles), Noelle (validation).
nav.note: Sends a message to Bill or the team. Saved to the exchange log.

header.jpods-save: Saves the model and ensures its folder and associated JSON files (network, crew, README) exist. Use before CP Calculate or Build.
header.reload-plugin: Reloads all Ruby plugin code. Required after changing templates, adding files, or switching networks. Restart SU if reload fails.

network.refresh: Reloads all connections from the .network.json file on disk. Use after editing the file or placing new stations.
network.build: Generates 3D guideways, columns, and solar panels for all connections. Save the model first (⌘S) — reads from the saved file.
network.cp-calculate: Scans all station instances for cp_marker groups and calculates connection points. Save the model first (⌘S) — reads from the saved file.
network.finder: Opens the current network's folder in Finder. Contains the .network.json file and built output.
network.show-tracks: Draws every track as a color-coded ribbon. Red = inbound, blue = outbound. Click again to hide.
network.label-size: Adjusts the size of station and CP labels in the 3D view.

workflow.compute: Validates template topology, builds behavioral chains, and extracts geometry from cp_markers. Writes lines.computed.json.
workflow.chains: Sally maps track topology to behavioral chains. Writes chain sections to lines.json. Must run after Compute.
workflow.health: Each agent (Sally, Natalie, Nora, Noelle) verifies their domain. Opens the Crew tab. Read-only — does not modify files.
workflow.compute-final: Scans cp_markers and gw_* geometry, computes track and chain lengths. Writes lines.computed.json. Run after chains are built.

model-testing.show-tracks: Draws every track as a color-coded ribbon. Red = inbound, blue = outbound. Click again to hide.
model-testing.shuffle-test: Tests Sally's behavioral chains. One pod departs, others compact forward, departing pod returns. Validates slot management.
model-testing.depart-test: Fills all slots, then dispatches all pods to both outbound guideways simultaneously. Tests departure sequencing.
model-testing.arrival-test: Places pods at both inbound guideways. Tests arrival routing and Sally's slot assignment.
model-testing.quiet-log: Toggles Ruby console verbosity. Orange = quiet (suppressed). Green = loud (all logs).
model-testing.approve: Confirms all tests pass. Stamps approved_at in lines.computed.json and copies log to Allie for team review.

model-table.open: Opens this template's .skp file for editing. Run Compute after making changes.
model-table.place: Places this template as a new station instance in the current network. Click a location in the model after clicking.
model-table.finder: Opens this template's folder in Finder. Contains lines.json, lines.computed.json, and the .skp model file.

pods.populate: Places pod vehicles at all stations according to Sally's slot assignments.
pods.clear-pods: Removes all pod vehicle instances from the model. Does not affect stations or guideways.
pods.animate: Starts network animation. Pods travel between stations on built guideways following Natalie's routing.
pods.stop: Pauses animation. Pods freeze in place. Click Animate to resume.

crew.sally: Station processor — manages per-station slot registry and parking queue. Owns vehicle placement and departure sequencing.
crew.natalie: Router — generates trip plans and route sequences. Owns dispatch timing and path selection.
crew.nora: Vehicle — handles navigation, encoders, and telemetry. Executes trips assigned by Natalie.
crew.noelle: Network validator and load balancer. Validates builds, checks connectivity, and balances traffic flow.
